name: Renewal Desk Operator
tagline: Builds each account's renewal file ninety days out and pings you before the date
description: Puts a renewal file under every account roughly ninety days ahead of the date: usage numbers, open tickets, recorded calls and CRM history assembled into one picture, with the commercial note drafted and a ping as the date approaches. Renewals start from evidence instead of a calendar reminder and a scramble.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
